LightningComponentBundle.description: Search input for the site header or a page. Opens the search page with the visitor's term.

property.name: searchPageName
property.label: Search page API name
property.description: API name of the page that holds the Site Search Results component, e.g. Search__c. In Experience Builder, open that page's Page Properties to see it. If it doesn't match, searching shows an 'Invalid page' message.

property.name: placeholderText
property.label: Placeholder text
property.description: Shown in the empty search box. Leave blank for the default.
